title: Forged admin cookie exposes private pages
evidence: Anonymous caller sets admin_session=anything. Five private admin routes returned200; students page contained fake Alice data. Normal no-cookie request redirects; /schedule verifies the token and rejects the forgery.
proposed_fix: Validate real server sessions in a shared admin route layout or every admin read entry; leave public/student/share paths separate. Test missing, forged, expired and student sessions across all admin pages.
surfaces: All admin data reads, credentials, teacher notes, invoices

title: Student post ownership is not enforced on reads or submissions
evidence: Alice logged in normally, requested her own student URL with Bob post id, and read BOB_PRIVATE_MARKER. Real action integration also persisted Alice submissions and quiz answers to Bob posts (auth stubs documented).
proposed_fix: Derive student identity from session; fetch post WHERE id=? AND student_id=? before reading files or writing answers; enforce post type and any explicit shared-post policy.
surfaces: Student classroom confidentiality, teacher submissions and grading

title: Private notifications can be read and cleared anonymously
evidence: Actual unauthenticated HTTP server-action calls retrieved admin and Bob private messages. Anonymous markNotificationRead returned success; isolated DB test confirms clearing all admin unread indicators.
proposed_fix: Require admin or owning student session; derive recipient from identity, constrain every update by recipient ownership, and bound the limit.
surfaces: Admin/student inboxes, unread counts and sensitive messages

title: Reschedule requests trust anonymous caller-supplied ownership
evidence: Anonymous HTTP request created a request for Bob class with Alice student id. Approval uses actual class owner for replacement but forged request student for notification.
proposed_fix: Require active student session, derive student id, verify owned scheduled class, validate preferences before writes, prevent duplicate pending requests.
surfaces: Student schedule requests, admin queue, wrong recipient notifications

title: Configured upload service is anonymously writable
evidence: Anonymous multipart HTTP request returned200 and an upload URL using a local fake connector. No real Google upload occurred. Exposure is conditional on production upload configuration.
proposed_fix: Authenticate admin or active student before form parsing, derive student scope, validate file/type/size and map connector errors. Secure Apps Script endpoint separately if publicly deployed.
surfaces: Google Drive storage and upload quotas; public files

title: Concurrent invoice generation bills one lesson twice
evidence: Real actions against isolated SQLite: two simultaneous generations both succeeded and produced two invoice lines for the same RM80 lesson. Invoice-number retry does not reserve lessons.
proposed_fix: Transactionally select/reserve lessons, insert header/items and commit together; enforce unique active lesson billing claim after settling void/rebill semantics. Add parallel generation and partial-failure regressions.
surfaces: Customer invoices, outstanding balances and revenue

title: Rescheduling drops the free-trial classification
evidence: Real reschedule approval changed is_trial1 to0 on replacement rows. Completing replacement then uses ordinary fee formula (downstream money traced). All three replacement paths omit the flag. Whether a rescheduled trial should remain free needs confirmation because documentation also says rescheduled lessons use normal rates.
proposed_fix: Read and copy is_trial through a shared replacement-class constructor; test all three entry points and later invoice line generation.
surfaces: Trial classes and parent invoice charges

title: Parent outstanding balance includes canceled invoices
evidence: Browser fixture had RM80 sent + RM80 canceled: parent Outstanding displayed RM160; expected RM80 and admin predicate excludes canceled.
proposed_fix: Use one shared outstanding predicate/aggregate excluding canceled/paid statuses; add status-transition and parent/admin parity tests.
surfaces: Parent debt claim versus admin balances

title: Local datetime input is interpreted in UTC on the server
evidence: Actual createClassQuick input10:00 stored10:00Z and renders18:00 MYT. Invoice bounds and recurring dates use same server-local Date pattern (traced).
proposed_fix: Introduce explicit Asia/Kuala_Lumpur wall-time/date-bound conversion to UTC. Apply consistently to one-off/update/reschedule/recurrence/invoice actions and default inputs. Test midnight/month-end.
surfaces: Every calendar, invoice period, dashboard and notification time

title: Invoice dialog chooses the wrong month boundary dates in KL
evidence: Real browser timezone Asia/Kuala_Lumpur displayed October31–November29 as November defaults. Can include October work and omit November30.
proposed_fix: Format local calendar dates without toISOString date truncation; coordinate with F09 server interpretation.
surfaces: Month-end invoice lesson inclusion

title: Resolved reschedule requests can be approved repeatedly
evidence: Real action test approved request twice and persisted two replacement classes. Rejecting an approved request changes request status without undoing replacement (traced).
proposed_fix: Pending-only conditional transition inside transaction, idempotency key/unique replacement relation, eligibility check and reject or no-op replays.
surfaces: Duplicate bookings and contradictory student notifications

title: Failed multi-step mutations can leave partial state
evidence: Actual cancel+reschedule invalid date throws after original is already canceled. Invoice and approval workflows also issue independent writes without rollback (traced).
proposed_fix: Validate complete input first; transaction domain writes and stored notifications; commit before invalidation. Fault-inject failures between writes.
surfaces: Lost appointments, incomplete invoices, false success histories

title: Recurring lessons have no meeting room and are pre-marked present
evidence: Real generated class had attendance=present and meeting_room=null; one-off path creates room and unmarked attendance. Meeting endpoint rejects roomless class.
proposed_fix: Create every lesson through common defaults: fresh unique room and NULL attendance. Propose separate reviewed remediation for existing generated records.
surfaces: Recurring video lessons, attendance summaries

title: Malformed recurrence values can cause unbounded server work
evidence: day_of_week99 can never satisfy getDay comparison; nonpositive custom interval can move backward indefinitely. Intentionally not executed to avoid hanging the machine.
proposed_fix: Validate finite day0..6, positive bounded interval/duration, ordered valid dates and max generation count/horizon before any write.
surfaces: Server availability and runaway class creation

title: Student sessions ignore server expiry and deactivation
evidence: Actual auth module with fake cookies and real SQLite returned student1 after active0; token equality lacks server expiry. Browser layout denies inactive users, but guarded actions can still accept the identity.
proposed_fix: Add expiring server-side student sessions and an explicit deactivation access policy; revoke or restrict tokens on deactivation per Q3.
surfaces: Former students writing notes/submissions or joining rooms

title: Fresh database silently omits username uniqueness
evidence: On first migration idx_students_username was absent because index creation precedes username ALTER and exception is swallowed. A later migration may repair it; one-process first boot remains unprotected.
proposed_fix: Add columns before indexes; distinguish already-exists from real failures, coordinate one migration promise and validate constraints. Handle existing duplicate usernames explicitly.
surfaces: Login identity uniqueness and startup reliability

title: Attendance percentage uses three incompatible formulas
evidence: Present+late+absent completed fixture computes admin33%, parent67%; adding unmarked completed produces parent dashboard50% versus attendance67%. Cancellation representation also removes absent lessons from completed-only denominators.
proposed_fix: Agree late/absent/canceled/unmarked denominator policy, then centralize formula and disclose pending attendance separately.
surfaces: Admin and parent attendance trust

title: Dashboard current-month and today queries use inconsistent windows
evidence: Classes This Month counts every class after month start, including December in November; agenda compares UTC date(timestamp) to MYT today.
proposed_fix: Use explicit half-open UTC bounds derived from MYT day/month for counts/hours/cash revenue and agenda. Separate cash chart policy question.
surfaces: Dashboard KPIs and daily agenda

title: Mixed SQLite/ISO timestamp strings show past lessons as upcoming
evidence: On same UTC date ISO T sorts after SQLite space:01:00 lesson compares greater than now15:00. Other views use ISO bounds and exclude it.
proposed_fix: Normalize comparisons with consistently encoded UTC bounds or numeric date operations. Test same-day past/future across roles.
surfaces: Parent and admin upcoming lists

title: Preview limits are presented as total counts
evidence: Parent has eight future classes but query LIMIT5 and UI says five upcoming; detail invoice total caps at10.
proposed_fix: Use separate full COUNT queries and accurate preview labels; provide pagination/full-history route for truncated lists.
surfaces: Parent/student counts and per-student history

title: Resubmission UI contradicts recorded policy and retains prior grade
evidence: Recorded prior Q5 allows latest submission replacing previous; UI removes form after first turn-in. Direct upsert changes content but leaves grade/graded_at, implying new content was graded.
proposed_fix: Provide resubmit form with current content; decide grade reset/version behavior, then enforce consistently in action and display.
surfaces: Student corrections and teacher grading

title: Calendar drag/resize gestures are enabled without persistence callbacks
evidence: Actual controlled calendar store accepted proposal true but event date remained unchanged; wrapper has no update persistence callback. Browser drag gesture itself was not run.
proposed_fix: Disable unsupported drag/resize/range selection, or implement authorized persistence with rollback and cross-view refresh. Choose desired interaction scope in Q6.
surfaces: Admin calendar actions versus student/parent persisted schedule

title: Meeting note save race can lose latest text while showing Saved
evidence: Save A starts; user types B; A finishes and marks all text saved; leave before B debounce skips save and unmount cancels timer. DB keeps A. No delayed-network browser execution yet.
proposed_fix: Track edited/saved revision or exact text, serialize saves, await latest flush before navigation and warn on unload; test delayed/out-of-order acknowledgments.
surfaces: Teacher and student private notes

title: Inline-created topics cannot be selected in the open post dialog
evidence: TopicSelector snapshots props once; createTopic refreshes props but localTopics is unchanged and returned id is discarded. Toast succeeds while new option remains absent until remount.
proposed_fix: Use current props or append/select returned topic immediately; avoid stale copies and preserve entered form data.
surfaces: Teacher topic organization and assignment grouping

title: Configured JaaS room isolation and copied links are inconsistent
evidence: When JaaS configured, tokens authorize room wildcard while app route authorizes one class; calendar copies free meet.jit.si URL rather than app/JaaS room. External video not tested.
proposed_fix: Bind JWT to authorized room and copy canonical authenticated /meeting/:id app link. Verify configured JaaS with separate student contexts before rollout.
surfaces: Private video rooms and joining tutor/student together

title: Shared server validation is missing for money, duration, grades and states
evidence: Negative hourly rates/durations and arbitrary runtime status strings pass Number/TypeScript-only checks. Numeric grade999/100 bypasses native validation because Return is not a form submit.
proposed_fix: Use shared runtime schemas for Quick/form variants, finite nonnegative rates, positive durations, enums and grade rules; clarify extra credit/letter grades rather than inventing policy.
surfaces: Wrong charges, impossible state labels and misleading grades

title: Equivalent action paths produce different notifications/invalidation
evidence: Quick cancel notifies, form cancel does not; direct reschedule/recurrence omit class notifications; report variants invalidate different surfaces. Already-open role pages have no realtime updates.
proposed_fix: Centralize domain events/invalidation after commit; agree which events notify. Test immediate unchanged view versus refetch rather than claiming realtime that is not promised.
surfaces: Student inboxes, parent reports and stale open pages

title: Canceled/absent classes are included in month-end invoices contrary to user rule
evidence: User clarified12Nov: absences free; canceled classes must be omitted entirely. Focused real-module/SQLite test: attended80 + canceled0 line + completed/absent80 produced total160 rather than80. Both generation paths include canceled zero-value rows and price completed+absent normally; refs shared. See /workspace/scratch/policy-results.json.
proposed_fix: Select billable completed non-absent classes only, omit canceled/absent rows in both paths; preserve trial zero-price policy unless changed. Test end-of-month negative/positive inclusion.
surfaces: Parent invoices and intended absence treatment

title: Stopping recurrence hard-deletes scheduled history instead of canceling future lessons
evidence: User requires future cancellation with history preserved. Focused real-module/SQLite test confirmed both past and future scheduled rows were deleted; only completed row survived, losing its recurrence link. See /workspace/scratch/policy-results.json.
proposed_fix: Transactionally cancel only future scheduled children, preserve past/all lesson rows and recurrence history or soft-stop flag; decide exact stop boundary in MYT.
surfaces: Attendance history, parent schedule, notes and reschedule request cascades

title: Installed framework/dependency tree has published vulnerability advisories
evidence: npm audit returned13 vulnerable packages:1 critical,8 high,3 moderate,1 low. Installed Next14.2.33 is flagged including server-action DoS advisories. Registry result is advisory evidence, not proof every exploit is reachable.
proposed_fix: Review advisory applicability and upgrade to supported patched compatible releases with frozen lockfile rebuild and role/scenario regressions. Do not run npm audit fix blindly; some entries report no automatic fix.
surfaces: Public server runtime and build-tool supply chain

title: Reminder toggle enables permission but schedules no class reminders
evidence: Only immediate confirmation Notification exists. There is no reminder scheduler, push subscription or service worker; UI promises notifications before upcoming classes.
proposed_fix: Either remove reminder promise and accurately label permission, or define delivery/lead-time/tab-closed requirements and implement them.
surfaces: Tutor expectation of class reminders

title: Calendar primitives disagree on viewport and trigger contracts
evidence: SSR proves expected scroll viewport slot absent and unsupported render prop leaks to DOM. Time scrolling cannot find viewport (traced). Month button renders and browser menu opens; not a broken navigation claim.
proposed_fix: Align stable viewport attributes/selectors; use actual Radix asChild trigger composition. Recheck scroll-to-hour, drag auto-scroll, overflow height, tooltip and menu.
surfaces: Week/day calendar usability and accessibility

title: Invoice status filter controls do not filter
evidence: Status badges have hover/cursor styling but no click handler, link or query filter; table always renders all invoices.
proposed_fix: Implement URL status filtering or remove interaction affordance and label as status counts.
surfaces: Admin invoice navigation

title: QR upload size promise disagrees with action limit
evidence: UI says2MB; server rejects above512000bytes. A700KB image meets UI promise and fails save.
proposed_fix: Align displayed limit with existing500KB limit or explicitly approve increasing validated size.
surfaces: Tutor settings upload errors

title: CSV escaping does not neutralize spreadsheet formulas
evidence: Values beginning =,+,-,@ can be interpreted as formulas by spreadsheet software; quoting delimiters does not neutralize formulas. Inputs are largely admin-entered, so risk depends on trusted-data assumptions.
proposed_fix: Offer safe spreadsheet encoding for untrusted cell prefixes; preserve legitimate phone/string intent and test Excel-compatible export.
surfaces: Downloaded roster/classes/invoice spreadsheets

title: Global viewport limits browser zoom
evidence: maximumScale1 restricts zoom in browsers that honor it. Actual assistive-device behavior was not tested.
proposed_fix: Remove maximumScale restriction and verify responsive layouts plus zoom.
surfaces: Low-vision/mobile users

title: Setup/security documentation contradicts current implementation
evidence: README describes no accounts/local better-sqlite3 although current code requires libSQL URL and login; security docs describe old session store and middleware guarantees. Historical audit marks /api removed but current middleware includes it.
proposed_fix: Update verified setup, auth architecture and known limitations after approved code fixes; retain historical audit as history.
surfaces: Future changes based on incorrect assumptions
